subject: Hero (Heron) of Alexandria (fl. c. 60 CE) — Metrica I–III, Definitiones, Catoptrica, Dioptra
public_domain_declaration: All archival critical editions ingested into this repository were published between 1864 and 1912 and are in the worldwide public domain. All English translations in docsrc/metrica/ are original scholarly translations prepared directly from the public-domain Greek editions for GEOMETOR.

archival_editions.title: Heronis Alexandrini Opera quae supersunt omnia, Vol. III: Rationes dimetiendi et Commentatio dioptrica (Metrica & Dioptra)

Codex Parisinus suppl. gr. 607 (fols. 62r–82v — primary witness of Dioptra)

manuscript_witnesses: Olympiodorus, In Aristotelis Meteora III.2 (pp. 368–372 Schmidt — Greek shortest-path proof)
Codex Ottobonianus lat. 1850 (William of Moerbeke 1269 Latin translation of Catoptrica)
